description.en:
NEXFORM W1 is a wheeled dual-arm robot for service workflows, embodied-AI research and data collection. A height-adjustable torso brings its arms to different working levels, while perception hardware and a mobile base support navigation and interaction. The manufacturer describes autonomous operation and several forms of teleoperation, including VR and software control.

Its development environment supports collecting demonstrations, training models and deploying control policies, with SDK, ROS and simulation integration. W1 is offered in several configurations with different arm, compute, power and mobility arrangements. Hotel service, retail handling and logistics sorting are proposed applications, with suitability depending on configuration and task integration.
